summary: Largo Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 10,200,000 common shares plus accompanying warrants at a combined price of $0.56, with warrants exercisable at $0.70 for five years. The September 24, 2026 securities purchase agreement includes insider participation by ARC Fund IV (2,321,428 units) and officer James Bannantine (178,571 units); H.C. Wainwright acts as exclusive placement agent. Closing expected on or about September 29, 2026. This is a routine equity financing, not a special situation; watch warrant overhang and TSX listing approval risk.
